The slice render moved from overview-injection (`w32m`) to a **dedicated per-tool `readme` page** (`/tools/<tool>/readme`, sidebar "Readme") — a new generated/synced page type, sibling of the generated `commands` page; `<ReadmeSlice>` removed from all 7 `overview.mdx`, which are **thinned to directory entries** (GithubButton + 1–2 sentence framing + nav links). Distinguished the new thin overview from the original "short pages, link to GitHub" stance: depth is now ON the site (the readme page, sourced from the canonical README), not off-site on GitHub. The `vn39` cross-check is now **report-only** for the pulled slice (canonical README rendered verbatim; divergence is a non-fatal CI warning, never withheld) — a hard rule only for hand-written prose. Both stay single-sourced from `help/*.json`; the parse is display-only (never derives the command tree), so §5 and the anti-drift intent are preserved. - **Update** [tool-page-rubric](/conventions/tool-page-rubric.md) — Change `u4di`: added the [right-rail "On this page" ToC](#right-rail-on-this-page-toc-generated-dispatcher-routed--change-u4di) section + two Design Decisions. The generated/synced `readme` page now gets a custom build-time ToC (nested H2/H3 from `content/<tool>/README.md`) via NEW `src/lib/readme-toc.ts` + NEW `ReadmeToc.astro`/`ReadmeMobileToc.astro` (separate from the commands components, PE scroll-spy tracking both H2 and H3). Established the **dispatcher pattern**: the single Starlight `TableOfContents`/`MobileTableOfContents` override slot is now `TocDispatcher`/`MobileTocDispatcher`, routing by `starlightRoute.id` → CommandsToc / ReadmeToc / `<Default />` (commands output preserved byte-for-byte); the next ToC variant extends the dispatcher, not a new slot. Slugs are single-sourced through the same `createMarkdownProcessor({})` render `ReadmeSlice` uses (`href === id` by construction; no `github-slugger` dep, no second slug path) — see [readme-extraction](/conventions/readme-extraction.md#slug-single-sourcing-rendered-ids--toc-hrefs-via-one-processor-change-u4di). `starlight-readme-toc` added to the `terminal.css` ToC selectors + H3 indent (dark-mode parity via shared `--c-*` vars). (u4di)
- **Update** [tool-page-rubric](/conventions/tool-page-rubric.md) — Change `w32m`: **revised the tool-page-depth stance** (backed by [constitution](../../../fab/project/constitution.md) v2.1.0, the new Tool-Page Depth constraint). Added the [pulled-README-slice exception](#pulled-readme-slice-exception-change-w32m) — deep prose, referenced screenshots, and rendered diagrams MAY now appear on tool pages when **mechanically synced** from the canonical README (`<ReadmeSlice>` injected into each `overview.mdx` under `<GithubButton>`, daily-pulled to `content/<slug>/README.md`, `vn39`-gated), parallel to the generated Command-reference exception. Reframed the "SHALL NOT contain Screenshots/diagrams/depth" bans as applying to **hand-written** content only, and revised the "Short pages, not deep docs" decision to "deep but synced, not hand-copied." Mechanics in [readme-extraction](/conventions/readme-extraction.md); contract in [`docs/specs/readme-extraction-contract.md`](../../specs/readme-extraction-contract.md). (w32m)
